Clamping limits a value to lie within a chosen range.
The function takes a value and two bounds as arguments.
Clamping is common in graphics, audio and user interfaces.
This module is small and has no third-party dependencies.

Range limits often come from configuration or user input.
Numbers passed to the function are usually integers.
